proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend: connection metadata/handshake is redesigned (including ready sync), QP setup adds FLID/subnet routing and ECE negotiation, traffic-class handling is updated, and receive-size reporting behavior changes. Added memory-module review is needed because MR registration now uses a per-device refcounted cache with new ownership/release semantics. Added gin-module review is needed because GIN IB paths now use the new accept/connect cancellation and listener-close flow, with GIN-specific FIFO traffic-class behavior.
